prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1035; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording for this, but I understand you need it for the file. Just note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the accident happened?

A: It was at an intersection in Katy, Texas. I was going through on a green light when another car came across from the side and hit my driver's side door.

Q: Which direction were you traveling, and what did you see before impact?

A: I was heading straight through. The light had been green for a bit. I didn't see the other vehicle until it was almost on me. I tried to brake but there wasn't time.

Q: Did the other driver say anything at the scene?

A: They said they didn't see me. They apologized, and then they seemed upset and asked me not to call the police. I told them I had to.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My right knee hit the dashboard and the door frame. It swelled up fast, and I've been having trouble putting weight on it. I went to an urgent care clinic the same day and they took X-rays and told me to follow up with a specialist.

Q: Have you seen anyone since then for the knee?

A: I've had two more appointments. The doctor mentioned possible ligament damage and ordered an MRI. I'm still waiting on the results and I'm using crutches around the house.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I've always followed traffic rules and I want this handled fairly. I'll send you the clinic records when I get them.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
